import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int mod = 1000000007;
    static int m;
    static int n;
    static long[] dig;
    static int cnt;
    static Matrix[] pre;
    static Matrix[] suf;
    static Matrix[][] f;
    static Matrix g;

    static class Matrix {
        long[][] a;

        Matrix() {
            a = new long[35][35];
        }
    }

    static Matrix multiply(Matrix x, Matrix y) {
        Matrix z = new Matrix();
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                z.a[i][j] = 0;
                for (int k = 0; k < m; k++) {
                    z.a[i][j] = (z.a[i][j] + x.a[i][k] * y.a[k][j]) % mod;
                }
            }
        }
        return z;
    }

    static Matrix power(Matrix x, long y) {
        Matrix z = new Matrix();
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                z.a[i][j] = (i == j) ? 1 : 0;
            }
        }
        while (y > 0) {
            if ((y & 1) == 1) {
                z = multiply(z, x);
            }
            x = multiply(x, x);
            y >>= 1;
        }
        return z;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        long tmp = n;
        cnt = -1;
        dig = new long[75];
        while (tmp != 0) {
            cnt++;
            dig[cnt] = tmp % m;
            tmp /= m;
        }

        pre = new Matrix[75];
        suf = new Matrix[75];
        f = new Matrix[75][35];

        for (int i = 0; i <= m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
                f[0][i] = new Matrix();
                f[0][i].a[j][i] = 1;
                f[0][i].a[j][j] = 1;
            }
        }

        g = new Matrix();
        g.a[0][m] = 1;

        for (int i = 1; i <= cnt; i++) {
            // pre computation
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                if (i == 1 && j == 0) {
                    pre[j] = f[i - 1][0];
                } else {
                    pre[j] = multiply(pre[j - 1], f[i - 1][j]);
                }
            }
            // suf computation
            for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
                if (j == m - 1) {
                    suf[j] = f[i - 1][j];
                } else {
                    suf[j] = multiply(f[i - 1][j], suf[j + 1]);
                }
            }
            f[i][0] = suf[0];
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                f[i][j] = multiply(suf[j], pre[j - 1]);
            }
        }

        int cur = 0;
        for (int i = cnt; i >= 0; i--) {
            while (dig[i] > 0) {
                g = multiply(g, f[i][cur]);
                cur = (cur + 1) % m;
                dig[i]--;
            }
        }

        long ans = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ans = (ans + g.a[0][i]) % mod;
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
